coding.note: Release report for the Zamba2 family. Architecture improvements are included from the explicit contribution-style list on page 2. The report asserts architecture ablations and parameter/FLOP matching, but supplies no element-specific controlled results or loss curves in the provided text; these claims are conservatively coded NO rather than treating assertions as demonstrated ablations. Data sources are disclosed, but component proportions and the full annealing mixture are not. Compute disclosure combines the 16-node, 8xH100 hardware description on page 2 with approximately 20/40/60-day training durations on page 3. Comparator names follow Table I literally, including potentially inconsistent model labels. Comparator evaluation provenance and training seed counts are not stated.
